info.title: Android SIM SMS Gateway API
info.description: Administrator API for the consent-based SMS gateway. Authenticate with POST /api/v1/auth/login. Browser clients use the HttpOnly session cookie and must send header `x-smsgw-csrf: 1` on writes; scripts may use `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

post.summary: Sign in and receive a session (cookie + token)
Revoke the current session
Change own password; revokes all other sessions
Create an administrator. A one-time temporary password is returned once and must be changed at first sign-in.

patch.summary: Change role, name or active status

post.summary: Issue a new temporary password and sign the user out everywhere

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Name, reference number, email, or trailing phone digits

post.summary: Create one contact. Invalid or duplicate numbers are rejected with details (never silently changed).

patch.summary: Edit a contact. Changing the phone re-validates it.

delete.summary: Soft-delete a contact; suppression records for the number are kept

post.summary: Add/remove tags and group memberships for many contacts at once

delete.summary: Delete a group (contacts are kept). Refused if used by a non-draft campaign.

post.summary: Record consent being granted or withdrawn for a purpose (append-only history)
Opt a phone number out immediately. Cancels its queued messages and records consent withdrawal.
Administrative suppression (complaint, wrong number, carrier block)
Lift a suppression. For opt-outs, record the evidence of renewed consent in the note.
Create a DRAFT campaign. Requires an Idempotency-Key header; retries with the same key return the same campaign.
Dry-run recipient checks (validity, opt-out, consent, duplicate numbers, limit), personalised samples, segment and cost estimate. Nothing is queued.
Queue the personalised message to one authorised test number (Settings → test_numbers). Sent before any campaign message.
DRAFT → PENDING_APPROVAL (runs all recipient checks)
Approve and queue. Re-runs every check, freezes the recipient list and creates one message per recipient. Requires typing the campaign name.
APPROVED/SCHEDULED → RUNNING now
Cancel every unsent message. Messages already confirmed for sending cannot be recalled.

get.summary: Per-recipient results as CSV (masked numbers unless contacts.read_full)

post.summary: Give every dead-lettered message (temporary errors that used up their automatic retries) one more attempt. Permanent rejections are not included.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: Exact action or prefix ending in "." e.g. "campaign."

put.summary: Change one setting (the kill switch has its own endpoint)

post.summary: Engage or release the global kill switch. While engaged, no new messages are handed to any phone.
Encoding, segment count and characters forcing Unicode for a message or template
Normalise up to 100 numbers to E.164 without saving anything
Exchange a one-time pairing code (from the dashboard QR) for a device token
Report health; receive current configuration and commands
Report the SIM selected for sending
Receive a batch of messages to send (each must still be confirmed just before sending)
Ask permission to send one leased message now. The phone must not send unless the answer is SEND.
Report sent results, delivery reports, opt-out replies and diagnostics (idempotent, batched)
Give back leased messages the phone will not send (pause, emergency stop, shutdown)

get.summary: Paired phones with health and today’s usage

post.summary: Create a one-time pairing code and QR for a new phone (valid 10 minutes)

patch.summary: Rename or change pacing. Interval is a floor; the phone never sends faster.

post.summary: Stop leasing new messages to this phone
Resume (also clears an emergency stop)
Emergency stop: the phone drops every unsent leased message at its next contact
Permanently unpair this phone

get.summary: Per-recipient message tracking. Use status=UNKNOWN for the reconciliation queue, dead_letter=true for exhausted retries.

parameters.name: phone
parameters.description: Full number or at least 4 trailing digits

get.summary: Full history: attempts, part results, delivery reports, retries, reconciliations

post.summary: One more attempt for a FAILED message (never for opted-out recipients; invalid numbers need force)
Resolve an UNKNOWN message before any resend

note.description: How you established this, e.g. "Checked Sent folder on the phone"

post.summary: Step 1: upload a CSV or XLSX (multipart field "file", optional field "country"). Rows are validated and staged; nothing is saved to contacts yet.
Step 2: create contacts from the staged rows

get.summary: Export contacts (streamed). Full numbers need contacts.read_full; every export is audited.

post.summary: Erase a person’s data (data-protection request). Removes name, email, reference and number from the contact and its messages. Any opt-out for the number is kept so they are never messaged again.

get.summary: Overview numbers for the dashboard home page

post.summary: Run the retention purge now (dry_run shows what would be deleted)
